formNameMismatch.description: Tests reference 'registerForm' but component has 'step1Form' and 'step2Form'

fieldNameMismatch.description: Tests reference 'email' field but form no longer has it

methodNameMismatch.description: Tests call isFieldInvalid() but component has isStep1FieldInvalid/isStep2FieldInvalid

apiMethodMismatch.description: Tests mock api.register but component calls api.registerSendCode/api.registerComplete

rootCause: Component was refactored from single-form registration to two-step registration with completely different form structure, method names, and template.
